description: This file declares the CasimirController class, which provides an interface for controlling RF communication, including connecting via TCP or Unix socket, muting/unmuting, setting power levels, sending broadcasts, polling for NFC-A + ISO-DEP, and sending APDU commands. It includes method declarations, class members, and external dependencies relevant to RF packet handling and file descriptors.
external_methods: Result<std::tuple<std::vector<uint8_t>, std::string, bool, uint32_t, uint32_t, uint32_t, double>> SendBroadcast(std::vector<uint8_t> data, std::string type, bool crc, uint8_t bits, uint32_t bitrate, uint32_t timeout, double power)

classes.name: CasimirController
classes.description: A class providing RF control functionalities such as connecting via network sockets, muting, unmuting, setting power levels, broadcasting, polling for NFC, and sending APDU commands. It manages a socket connection and RF power level state.

methods.name: ConnectToTcpPort
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a specified TCP port for RF communication.

methods.name: ConnectToUnixSocket
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a Unix domain socket for RF communication.

methods.name: SetPowerLevel
methods.description: Sets the RF transmission power level.

methods.name: SendBroadcast
methods.description: Sends a broadcast RF message with specified parameters.

methods.name: Poll
methods.description: Polls for NFC-A and ISO-DEP responses.

methods.name: SendApdu
methods.description: Sends an APDU command to a specified receiver.

methods.name: SelectNfcA
methods.description: Selects NFC-A and returns the sender ID.

methods.name: SelectT4AT
methods.description: Selects T4AT by choosing NFC-A listener using ISO-DEP protocol.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads an exact number of bytes with a timeout.

methods.name: ReadRfPacket
methods.description: Reads an RF packet with a timeout.
